note: Control counts of the default views Prompt 167 folded, held by e2e/progressiveDisclosure.spec.js. A control is a link, button, form control or disclosure summary that is rendered, not hidden, not inert and not inside a closed disclosure (or a folded settings section), counted in the whole panel whatever the viewport. `before` is v3 at d3355e4f, measured in Chromium on macOS on 2026-10-21; `ceiling` is what the default view may show now. A count that rises fails; a new control goes behind the disclosure unless its decision-register row says why not, and never when the task rule applies (DESIGN_SYSTEM.md, More).
